extension_record.scope: Exploratory fixed13-panel extension;2 RNA endpoints×3 barcode sensitivities
extension_record.source_selection: All18 human-snRNA libraries equally averaged within14 literal roots
extension_record.score: Sum per-gene across-root midranks then rank score for Spearman, equivalent equal positive mean without floating tie break; reranked after root resampling/deletion
extension_record.part_whole: CSPG4 removed from its core-protein panel; other fixed genes unchanged
extension_record.testing: 10000 two-sided target-root permutations; BH26 each sensitivity and BH78 complete family;2000 reranked bootstrap attempts
extension_record.technical_covariates: None; no filtered-barcode QC mean assumed

limits: Literal roots are not verified independent clinical patients
Same assay does not remove composition/genotype/batch effects
RNA associations do not measure malignant cells, protein, glycan, sulfation, activity or treatment
Equal positive module coefficients are historical annotations, not validated pathway activities
